ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 35:65 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment to high-intensity light-grey/white pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Heavy dark-pixel pigmentation is concentrated along the peripheral trailing edges and surrounding the central notch. Dense, high-contrast mottling and focal speckling radiate from the central peduncle attachment toward the mid-lobes. Large, contiguous light-intensity fields are located in the central-upper regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of approximately 65-70 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. The outer lateral thirds of the trailing edges exhibit high-amplitude pixel variations (jagged peaks), while the sections proximal to the notch show lower-amplitude, smoother undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a sigmoid curve, characterized by concavity near the median notch transitioning into convexity toward the distal fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters (likely barnacle attachment sites) are visible on the far lateral tips and intermittently along the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible: specifically, two long diagonal rake marks on the lower left lobe and several shorter, vertical parallel scratches on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged indentation and loss of smooth contour on the distal margin of the right fluke tip, consistent with structural tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small circular dark pigmentation 'ring' or 'O' shape is visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe; significant specular highlights from water droplets are present along the trailing edge.
